source_biological_sample_panel.phenotypic_data_source: NMNS Japan, Flora of North America and European botanical concept descriptions; original Moreyra S1 includes BioSample/SRR/voucher but not Siniscalchi's nine phenotype traits
source_biological_sample_panel.corrected_duplicate_same_SRR: SAMN44017865 / SRR30887251 kept once as J38S038; earlier GLB2 duplicate excluded

tested_empirical_data.note: Three source trees reuse the same 51 molecular biological samples, not three independent evolutionary replicates

no_phylogeny_frequency_baseline.model: one-parameter Bernoulli observation model fitted once to 19 U and 8 D distinct source species/varietal concepts, independent tip limiting distribution of a high-rate reversible Markov process

model_adequacy_scientific_result.supported: ARD reversible CTMC accommodates original 8/27 observed D proportion, but its excess likelihood above one-frequency IID is only about 0.005 to 0.012 and descriptively loses 2.32 to 2.33 AICc points to the simpler independent-frequency source baseline in all three molecular panels.
model_adequacy_scientific_result.meaning: The apparently strong comparison of bidirectional models against strictly irreversible models is not reliable evidence of historical reversions or fitness selection. Under the fitted high q, state memory is lost along 69-73 percent of the 100 rooted ingroup branches.
limitations: IID is a model diagnostic, not an accepted biological assumption that real species phenotypes are evolutionarily independent
AICc uses 27 botanically scored species/variety concepts as a rough n and is descriptive without phylogenetic/spatial calibration
24 other Cirsium nuclear tips have no independent U/D botanical state; source taxonomy and source specimen selection are biased
Original tree branches are substitutions/site; fitted Mk rates are not rates per million years and hidden cycles are not observed independent U->D/D->U origins
No matched world phylogeny-wide native-filtered BIO15/BIO1 niche centroids, no historical geological branch climate or pollinator fitness data
Moreyra original final worldwide 294-BioSample 350-locus species tree not recovered or independently reconstructed here
